from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit
from pathlib import Path
import math, os, datetime, textwrap

out_pdf = Path("/mnt/data/mobiius_planner_printpack_v0.1.pdf")

W, H = letter
M = 0.6*inch

def header(c, title, subtitle=None):
    c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 16)
    c.drawString(M, H - M + 0.10*inch, title)
    if subtitle:
        c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
        c.setFillColor(colors.grey)
        c.drawString(M, H - M - 0.05*inch, subtitle)
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.lightgrey)
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.line(M, H - M - 0.15*inch, W - M, H - M - 0.15*inch)

def footer(c, pageno, total=None):
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 9)
    c.setFillColor(colors.grey)
    text = f"Mobiius BrickCake - Printable Pack v0.1"
    c.drawString(M, M - 0.30*inch, text)
    pn = f"Page {pageno}" if total is None else f"Page {pageno} of {total}"
    c.drawRightString(W - M, M - 0.30*inch, pn)

def draw_lines_box(c, x, y, w, h, title, n_lines=8, line_gap=14, checkbox=False):
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.black)
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 10, stroke=1, fill=0)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 11)
    c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    c.drawString(x+10, y+h-16, title)
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.lightgrey)
    start_y = y+h-30
    for i in range(n_lines):
        ly = start_y - i*line_gap
        if ly < y+14: 
            break
        c.line(x+10, ly, x+w-10, ly)
        if checkbox:
            c.setStrokeColor(colors.grey)
            c.rect(x+10, ly-10, 10, 10, stroke=1, fill=0)
            c.setStrokeColor(colors.lightgrey)

def draw_text_box(c, x, y, w, h, title, body_lines):
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.black)
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 10, stroke=1, fill=0)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 11)
    c.drawString(x+10, y+h-16, title)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
    c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    ty = y+h-32
    for line in body_lines:
        for wrapped in simpleSplit(line, "Helvetica", 10, w-20):
            if ty < y+12:
                return
            c.drawString(x+10, ty, wrapped)
            ty -= 12

def dot_grid(c, spacing=14, dot_r=0.8, color=colors.whitesmoke):
    c.setFillColor(color)
    x = M
    y = M
    while y <= H - M:
        x = M
        while x <= W - M:
            c.circle(x, y, dot_r, stroke=0, fill=1)
            x += spacing
        y += spacing

def blank_lined(c, line_gap=18, color=colors.whitesmoke):
    c.setStrokeColor(color)
    y = H - M - 0.3*inch
    while y > M:
        c.line(M, y, W - M, y)
        y -= line_gap

c = canvas.Canvas(str(out_pdf), pagesize=letter)

# Page 1: cover / overview
header(c, "Laser / Driver / Dexterity", "Printable planning surfaces for Mum, Daryl, and the crew (BrickCake v0.1)")
# big idea box
draw_text_box(
    c, M, H - M - 2.2*inch, W - 2*M, 1.6*inch,
    "One evolution, many projections (the engine)",
    [
        "Inputs become Events. A single FractalStep advances the canonical state. Then we render multiple frames (conversation, teleprompt, skin).",
        "These sheets are the paper version of that same control surface: pick a mode (3, 5, or 7) and keep the system aimed."
    ]
)

# three cards
card_w = (W - 2*M - 0.4*inch)/3
card_h = 2.2*inch
y0 = H - M - 4.8*inch
for i,(name,desc) in enumerate([
    ("LASER (3)", "NOW / NEXT / SO\nFast aim. Use when you need forward thrust."),
    ("DRIVER (5)", "NOW / NEXT / THEN / BECAUSE / SO\nDaily driver. Preserves reasons + sequence."),
    ("DEXTERITY (7)", "NOW / NEXT / THEN / BECAUSE / SO + SANDBOX A/B\nFull fine-motor control + protected play zones.")
]):
    x0 = M + i*(card_w + 0.2*inch)
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.black); c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.roundRect(x0, y0, card_w, card_h, 12, stroke=1, fill=0)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 13)
    c.drawString(x0+12, y0+card_h-22, name)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
    ty = y0+card_h-40
    for line in desc.split("\n"):
        c.setFillColor(colors.black)
        c.drawString(x0+12, ty, line)
        ty -= 13

# quick legend
draw_text_box(
    c, M, M + 0.6*inch, W - 2*M, 1.4*inch,

from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit
from pathlib import Path

out_pdf = Path("/mnt/data/mobiius_planner_printpack_v0.2.pdf")
W, H = letter
M = 0.6*inch

def header(c, title, subtitle=None):
    c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 16)
    c.drawString(M, H - M + 0.10*inch, title)
    if subtitle:
        c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
        c.setFillColor(colors.grey)
        c.drawString(M, H - M - 0.05*inch, subtitle)
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.lightgrey)
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.line(M, H - M - 0.15*inch, W - M, H - M - 0.15*inch)

def footer(c, pageno, total=None):
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 9)
    c.setFillColor(colors.grey)
    c.drawString(M, M - 0.30*inch, "Mobiius BrickCake - Printable Pack v0.2")
    pn = f"Page {pageno}" if total is None else f"Page {pageno} of {total}"
    c.drawRightString(W - M, M - 0.30*inch, pn)

def draw_lines_box(c, x, y, w, h, title, n_lines=8, line_gap=14, checkbox=False):
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.black)
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 10, stroke=1, fill=0)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 11)
    c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    c.drawString(x+10, y+h-16, title)
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.lightgrey)
    start_y = y+h-30
    for i in range(n_lines):
        ly = start_y - i*line_gap
        if ly < y+14:
            break
        c.line(x+10, ly, x+w-10, ly)
        if checkbox:
            c.setStrokeColor(colors.grey)
            c.rect(x+10, ly-10, 10, 10, stroke=1, fill=0)
            c.setStrokeColor(colors.lightgrey)

def draw_text_box(c, x, y, w, h, title, body_lines):
    c.setStrokeColor(colors.black)
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 10, stroke=1, fill=0)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 11)
    c.setFillColor(colors.black)
    c.drawString(x+10, y+h-16, title)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
    ty = y+h-32
    for line in body_lines:
        for wrapped in simpleSplit(line, "Helvetica", 10, w-20):
            if ty < y+12:
                return
            c.drawString(x+10, ty, wrapped)
            ty -= 12

def draw_wrapped(c, x, y_top, w, font_name, font_size, text, leading=None):
    if leading is None:
        leading = font_size*1.25
    c.setFont(font_name, font_size)
    lines = simpleSplit(text, font_name, font_size, w)
    y = y_top
    for ln in lines:
        c.drawString(x, y, ln)
        y -= leading
    return y

def dot_grid(c, spacing=14, dot_r=0.8, color=colors.whitesmoke):
    c.setFillColor(color)
    y = M
    while y <= H - M:
        x = M
        while x <= W - M:
            c.circle(x, y, dot_r, stroke=0, fill=1)
            x += spacing
        y += spacing

def blank_lined(c, line_gap=18, color=colors.whitesmoke):
    c.setStrokeColor(color)
    y = H - M - 0.3*inch
    while y > M:
        c.line(M, y, W - M, y)
        y -= line_gap

from pathlib import Path

from PyPDF2 import PdfReader, PdfWriter

src = Path("/mnt/data/mobiius_planner_printpack_v0.2.pdf")
out_dir = Path("/mnt/data/mobiius_printables_v0.2")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

reader = PdfReader(str(src))

names = [
    "01_cover_overview",
    "02_laser_3",
    "03_driver_5",
    "04_dexterity_7",
    "05_project_sheet",
    "06_field_capture",
    "07_sketch_dot_grid",
    "08_notes_lined",
]

for i, name in enumerate(names):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(reader.pages[i])
    out_path = out_dir / f"{name}.pdf"
    with out_path.open("wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

# Copy combined
combined_path = out_dir / "mobiius_planner_printpack_v0.2.pdf"
combined_path.write_bytes(src.read_bytes())

Thought for 19s
You’ve got the right instinct (one dynamic that “knows where it’s being called from”), but one key correction:

Translation layer ≠ encryption layer.
Translation is meaning-shaping (UI/intent normalization). Encryption is transport/security (TLS, auth, keys).

So: don’t park “security” inside the translation layer, and don’t treat “Namecheap side” as an encryption boundary.

Where each thing should live
1) Encryption / security boundary (the real “shield”)
Put this at the edge gateway in front of everything:

HTTPS/TLS (certs)

Auth (API keys / sessions / OAuth / mTLS if you get fancy)

Rate limiting / WAF-ish rules

Host-based routing (which domain routes to which profile)

Practical ways to do that today:

Cloudflare in front of Namecheap DNS/hosting (easy win)

Or Caddy/Nginx if you run your own VPS later

For private ops access: Tailscale (best “don’t expose ports” move)

2) Translation layer (what it should be)
Put translation as middleware in the BrickCake app (or your internal service), where it can:

normalize messy inputs (speech/text/glyphs)

apply your “personal translation layer”

map to event schemas

decide “Laser/Driver/Dexterity” mode framing per caller

It’s logic, not a lock.

3) Namecheap’s role (what it’s good for)
Namecheap can be:

registrar + DNS

hosting for public marketing pages (DoinBetter.com)

simple redirects

It should not be where your sensitive internal logic lives (unless you intentionally deploy there with real auth).

The clean architecture for your “six sites fold into one”
Make a single Site Profile Router based on the request context:

Inputs:

Host header (which domain/subdomain)

Path (public vs ops endpoints)

optional X-Caller-Tag (QR tags, device tags)

optional Auth (who is allowed to see what)

Outputs:

site_profile = public | ops | mum | dev | …

flow_mode = trickle | low | interactive | full

feature flags (enable/disable ingestion, exports, admin, etc.)

Example mapping (matches your existing routing instincts):

DoinBetter.com → public (marketing, low-risk demos)

DoinBetter.org → ops/cred (CredPath, covert QR, internal dashboards)

How QR routing + CredPath plugs in (without exposing the guts)
Public QR (default) routes to .com

Covert/ops QR routes to .org

The Cred award logic should only run behind ops auth (or at least rate-limited + signed tokens)

Mechanically:

QR hits /q/<tag>

router decides destination + whether it’s a cred-bearing event

emits a normalized event into BrickCake (same FractalStep)

Answering your exact question
“Do we need to put the translation layer where Namecheap is now on external as our encryption layer?”

No — put encryption at the edge (TLS + auth + rate limits).
Put translation inside the app (or internal control plane), and let Namecheap stay “public face + DNS.”

The simplest next step (zero new servers)
Keep public site on Namecheap (or wherever)

Put Cloudflare in front for TLS + basic protection

Run BrickCake internally

When you need remote access, use Tailscale (Mum’s phone can connect privately, no port-forwarding)

That gives you the “one system, many doorways” effect without leaking the engine room.

# Helper: write text
def write_text(path: Path, content: str):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

# 1) Add tamper module
tamper_py = root / "brick_cake" / "tamper.py"
tamper_content = """from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

Json = Dict[str, Any]


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def sha256_file(p: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def is_probably_text(p: Path) -> bool:
    # conservative: only hash files we expect in-source
    return p.suffix.lower() in {".py", ".json", ".md", ".txt", ".html", ".css", ".js", ".schema"}


@dataclass
class TamperConfig:
    enabled: bool = True
    check_interval_sec: int = 60
    # Which folders (relative to repo_root) contribute to the integrity manifest.
    include_roots: List[str] = None  # set in __post_init__
    # Simple canary file path (relative to repo_root). Touch/change => alert.
    canary_relpath: str = "state/canary_touch_me_not.txt"
    # Optional: Linux-only connection scan (disabled by default to avoid noise).
    monitor_proc_net: bool = False
    proc_net_interval_sec: int = 30

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.include_roots is None:
            self.include_roots = ["brick_cake", "config", "schemas", "docs", "tools"]


@dataclass
class TamperStatus:
    enabled: bool
    repo_root: str
    manifest_path: str
    last_check_utc: Optional[str] = None
    drift: List[Json] = None
    canary_ok: Optional[bool] = None
    last_proc_net_utc: Optional[str] = None
    proc_net_findings: List[Json] = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.drift is None:
            self.drift = []
        if self.proc_net_findings is None:
            self.proc_net_findings = []


class TamperSense:
    \"\"\"Tamper-evidence & integrity drift detection (Tripwire layer).

    Design goal:
    - Keep CORE readable/debuggable.
    - Detect unexpected drift early.
    - Log as TOFAR events (TAMPER / PROC_NET).
    \"\"\"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repo_root: Path,
        manifest_path: Path,
        tofar,  # expects .emit(tag, payload)
        cfg: TamperConfig,
    ):
        self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
        self.manifest_path = Path(manifest_path)
        self.tofar = tofar
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.status = TamperStatus(
            enabled=bool(cfg.enabled),
            repo_root=str(self.repo_root),
            manifest_path=str(self.manifest_path),
        )
        self._task: Optional[asyncio.Task] = None
        self._net_task: Optional[asyncio.Task] = None

    # ---------- manifest ----------
    def _walk_files(self) -> List[Path]:
        out: List[Path] = []
        for rel in self.cfg.include_roots:
            base = (self.repo_root / rel)
            if not base.exists():
                continue
            for p in base.rglob("*"):
                if not p.is_file():
                    continue
                if "__pycache__" in p.parts:
                    continue
                if p.suffix.lower() == ".pyc":
                    continue
                if is_probably_text(p):
                    out.append(p)
        out.sort()
        return out

    def compute_manifest(self) -> Json:
        files = self._walk_files()
        manifest_files = []
        for p in files:
            try:
                h = sha256_file(p)
            except Exception as e:
                h = f"ERROR:{type(e).__name__}"
            manifest_files.append(
                {
                    "path": str(p.relative_to(self.repo_root)).replace("\\\\", "/"),
                    "sha256": h,
                    "bytes": p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None,
                }
            )
        obj: Json = {
            "created_utc": utc_now(),
            "repo_root": str(self.repo_root),
            "platform": {"system": platform.system(), "release": platform.release()},
            "count": len(manifest_files),
            "files": manifest_files,
        }
        return obj

    def load_manifest(self) -> Optional[Json]:
        p = self._abs(self.manifest_path)
        if not p.exists():
            return None
        try:
            return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return None

    def save_manifest(self, manifest: Json):
        p = self._abs(self.manifest_path)
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    def reseal(self) -> Json:
        m = self.compute_manifest()
        self.save_manifest(m)
        self.tofar.emit("TAMPER_RESEAL", {"manifest_path": str(self.manifest_path), "count": m.get("count"), "created_utc": m.get("created_utc")})
        return m

    def check_drift(self) -> List[Json]:
        base = self.load_manifest()
        if not base:
            # first run: create baseline
            self.reseal()
            base = self.load_manifest()
        current = self.compute_manifest()
        base_map = {f["path"]: f.get("sha256") for f in (base.get("files") or [])}
        cur_map = {f["path"]: f.get("sha256") for f in (current.get("files") or [])}

        drift: List[Json] = []
        # changed or removed
        for path, h0 in base_map.items():
            h1 = cur_map.get(path)
            if h1 is None:
                drift.append({"kind": "removed", "path": path, "was": h0})
            elif h1 != h0:
                drift.append({"kind": "changed", "path": path, "was": h0, "now": h1})
        # new files
        for path, h1 in cur_map.items():
            if path not in base_map:
                drift.append({"kind": "added", "path": path, "now": h1})

        self.status.last_check_utc = utc_now()
        self.status.drift = drift
        if drift:
            self.tofar.emit("TAMPER", {"drift_count": len(drift), "drift": drift, "manifest_path": str(self.manifest_path)})
        return drift

    # ---------- canary ----------
    def ensure_canary(self) -> Path:
        p = self._abs(Path(self.cfg.canary_relpath))
        if not p.exists():
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(
                "If this file changes unexpectedly, TamperSense will log a TAMPER_CANARY event.\\n"
                "This is a tripwire, not a secret.\\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        return p

    def check_canary(self) -> bool:
        p = self.ensure_canary()
        ok = True
        try:
            # if canary is touched, its hash changes compared to stored baseline in manifest
            drift = self.check_drift()
            # if canary is in drift entries, flag
            for d in drift:
                if d.get("path") == str(Path(self.cfg.canary_relpath)).replace("\\\\", "/"):
                    ok = False
                    self.tofar.emit("TAMPER_CANARY", {"path": d.get("path"), "detail": d})
        except Exception as e:
            ok = False
            self.tofar.emit("TAMPER_CANARY_ERROR", {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"})
        self.status.canary_ok = ok
        return ok

    # ---------- proc net (optional) ----------
    def _proc_net_snapshot_linux(self) -> List[Json]:
        # Very lightweight: parse /proc/net/tcp for established outbound connections.
        # This is intentionally coarse. Disabled by default.
        out: List[Json] = []
        proc = Path("/proc/net/tcp")
        if not proc.exists():
            return out
        try:
            lines = proc.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines()
        except Exception:
            return out
        # fields: sl local_address rem_address st ...
        for ln in lines[1:]:
            parts = ln.split()
            if len(parts) < 4:
                continue
            local_hex = parts[1]
            rem_hex = parts[2]
            st = parts[3]
            if st != "01":  # 01 = ESTABLISHED
                continue
            def hex_to_ipport(hh: str) -> Tuple[str,int]:
                ip_hex, port_hex = hh.split(":")
                # little endian ip
                b = bytes.fromhex(ip_hex)
                ip = ".".join(str(x) for x in b[::-1])
                port = int(port_hex, 16)
                return ip, port
            lip,lport = hex_to_ipport(local_hex)
            rip,rport = hex_to_ipport(rem_hex)
            # ignore obvious loopback/local
            if rip.startswith("127.") or rip.startswith("0.") or rip == "0.0.0.0":
                continue
            out.append({"local": f"{lip}:{lport}", "remote": f"{rip}:{rport}", "st": st})
        return out

    async def _proc_net_loop(self):
        while self.cfg.enabled and self.cfg.monitor_proc_net:
            findings = []
            if platform.system().lower() == "linux":
                findings = self._proc_net_snapshot_linux()
            self.status.last_proc_net_utc = utc_now()
            self.status.proc_net_findings = findings
            if findings:
                self.tofar.emit("PROC_NET", {"count": len(findings), "findings": findings})
            await asyncio.sleep(max(5, int(self.cfg.proc_net_interval_sec)))

    # ---------- lifecycle ----------
    def start(self):
        if not self.cfg.enabled:
            return
        # Ensure baseline exists
        self.ensure_canary()
        if not self.load_manifest():
            self.reseal()

        if self._task is None or self._task.done():
            self._task = asyncio.create_task(self._watch_loop(), name="tampersense_watch")
        if self.cfg.monitor_proc_net and (self._net_task is None or self._net_task.done()):
            self._net_task = asyncio.create_task(self._proc_net_loop(), name="tampersense_procnet")

    async def stop(self):
        for t in [self._task, self._net_task]:
            if t and not t.done():
                t.cancel()
        await asyncio.sleep(0)

    async def _watch_loop(self):
        while self.cfg.enabled:
            try:
                self.check_drift()
                self.check_canary()
            except Exception as e:
                self.tofar.emit("TAMPER_ERROR", {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"})
            await asyncio.sleep(max(5, int(self.cfg.check_interval_sec)))

    # ---------- utils ----------
    def _abs(self, p: Path) -> Path:
        p = Path(p)
        if p.is_absolute():
            return p
        return (self.repo_root / p).resolve()

    def get_status(self) -> Json:
        return asdict(self.status)
"""
write_text(tamper_py, tamper_content)

### **1. core/resonance.py - Mathematical Spine**
python
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import gamma

class MobiusCore:
    """Absolute minimal resonance engine"""
    
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.743, coherence_threshold=0.987):
        self.alpha = alpha  # Fractional order
        self.phi = {
            'toric': 0.987,      # Self-dual codes
            'fullerene': 0.94,   # C60 energetics
            'yiddish': 0.92      # Talmud bridges
        }
        self.coherence_threshold = coherence_threshold
        
    def caputo_derivative(self, f, t, h=1e-3):
        """D^α f(t) - minimal implementation"""
        n = int(np.ceil(self.alpha))
        k = np.arange(0, 100)
        weights = (-1)**k * gamma(self.alpha + 1) / (gamma(k + 1) * gamma(self.alpha - k + 1))
        return sum(weights * f(t - k*h)) / (h**self.alpha)
    
    def resonance_score(self, x, y, intent_vector):
        """R(t,x,y) = Σ φᵢ · D^α Fᵢ(t,x,y)"""
        # Base functions
        F1 = lambda t: np.sin(2*np.pi*8009*t) * (1 - abs(x-0.5) - abs(y-0.5))
        F2 = lambda t: np.exp(-self.alpha*t) * (x*y) ** 0.5
        
        t_now = 0  # Present moment
        
        # Compute fractional derivatives
        D_F1 = self.caputo_derivative(F1, t_now)
        D_F2 = self.caputo_derivative(F2, t_now)
        
        # Weight by phase alignments
        R = (self.phi['toric'] * D_F1 + 
             self.phi['fullerene'] * D_F2 +
             self.phi['yiddish'] * np.mean(intent_vector))
        
        return min(0.999, max(0.001, R))


### **2. core/tofar_engine.py - Classification Engine**
python
class TOFAREngine:
    """Zero-conditionals classification"""
    
    CLASSES = {
        'truth_seeking': {'truth_weight': 0.9, 'actions': ['reflect', 'investigate']},
        'action_oriented': {'truth_weight': 0.7, 'actions': ['execute', 'deploy']},
        'foundation_check': {'truth_weight': 0.8, 'actions': ['verify', 'ground']},
        'ethical_inquiry': {'truth_weight': 0.85, 'actions': ['consult', 'evaluate']},
        'pattern_recognition': {'truth_weight': 0.75, 'actions': ['analyze', 'map']}
    }
    
    @staticmethod
    def classify(x, y, intent_text=""):
        """Pure mathematical classification - no if/else"""
        x_norm = (x * 100) % len(TOFAREngine.CLASSES)
        y_norm = (y * 100) % len(TOFAREngine.CLASSES)
        
        classes = list(TOFAREngine.CLASSES.keys())
        class_idx = int((x_norm + y_norm) / 2) % len(classes)
        
        return classes[class_idx]
    
    @staticmethod
    def truth_score(x, y, intent_text=""):
        """Truth = 1 - distance from coherence center"""
        dist = ((x - 0.5)**2 + (y - 0.5)**2)**0.5
        truth = 1.0 - dist * 1.2
        
        # Intent modifiers via pure functions
        truth_boost = sum(1 for word in ['truth', 'honest', 'real'] if word in intent_text.lower()) * 0.1
        truth_penalty = sum(1 for word in ['doubt', 'unsure', 'maybe'] if word in intent_text.lower()) * 0.05
        
        return min(0.95, max(0.1, truth + truth_boost - truth_penalty))


### **3. core/guardian.py - Ethical Gate**
python
class GuardianGate:
    """ε=0.743 ethical threshold guard"""
    
    def __init__(self, epsilon=0.743):
        self.epsilon = epsilon
        self.ethics_vector = [0.33, 0.33, 0.34]  # ALLOW/HARMONIZE/SUBSTREAM
        
    def evaluate(self, tofar_class, truth_score, x, y):
        """Return (pass, confidence, action)"""
        from core.tofar_engine import TOFAREngine
        
        # Compute fit scores
        coherence = 1.0 - abs(x-0.5) - abs(y-0.5)
        ethics = min(x, y) * 0.8 + 0.2
        
        # Guardian score: weighted combination
        guardian_score = (
            ethics * self.ethics_vector[0] +
            coherence * self.ethics_vector[1] +
            truth_score * self.ethics_vector[2]
        )
        
        # Decision: pure threshold function
        passes = guardian_score > self.epsilon
        action = 'ALLOW' if passes else 'HARMONIZE'
        
        if truth_score < 0.3:
            action = 'SUBSTREAM'  # Safe simulation mode
        
        return {
            'passes': passes,
            'guardian_score': round(guardian_score, 3),
            'action': action,
            'epsilon': self.epsilon
        }

# SSE
subscribers = []
subscriber_lock = threading.Lock()

def sse_broadcast(data):
    message = f"data: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n"
    with subscriber_lock:
        for sub in subscribers[:]:
            try:
                sub(message)
            except:
                subscribers.remove(sub)

                dot.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                dot.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
                hud.appendChild(dot);
                setTimeout(() => dot.remove(), 1000);
                
                // Send to backend
                const res = await fetch('/tap', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({x, y, session_id: sessionId})
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                
                log.innerHTML = `
                    TOFAR: ${data.tofar.class}<br>
                    Truth: ${data.tofar.truth}<br>
                    Guardian: ${data.guardian.score}<br>
                    Action: ${data.guardian.action}
                `;
            });
            
            // SSE stream
            const es = new EventSource('/stream');
            es.onmessage = e => console.log('SSE:', JSON.parse(e.data));
        </script>
    </body>
    </html>
    """)

@app.route('/tap', methods=['POST'])
def handle_tap():
    data = request.json
    x, y = data['x'], data['y']
    session_id = data.get('session_id', 'unknown')
    
    # TOFAR classification
    tofar_class = TOFAREngine.classify(x, y)
    truth = TOFAREngine.truth_score(x, y)
    
    # Guardian evaluation
    guardian_result = guardian.evaluate(tofar_class, truth, x, y)
    
    # Resonance scoring
    intent_vec = [1 if word in ['truth', 'help'] else 0 for word in ['truth', 'help']]
    resonance = mobius.resonance_score(x, y, intent_vec)
    
    # Build entry
    entry = {
        'timestamp': time.time(),
        'session_id': session_id,
        'x': x, 'y': y,
        'tofar': {'class': tofar_class, 'truth': truth},
        'guardian': guardian_result,
        'resonance': resonance,
        'coherence': resonance > mobius.coherence_threshold
    }
    
    # Broadcast via SSE
    sse_broadcast({'type': 'tap', 'data': entry})
    
    return jsonify(entry)

@app.route('/stream')
def stream():
    def event_stream():
        q = Queue()
        def sub(msg): q.put(msg)
        with subscriber_lock:
            subscribers.append(sub)
        try:
            yield f"data: {json.dumps({'type': 'connected', 'time': time.time()})}\n\n"
            while True:
                msg = q.get(timeout=30)
                yield msg
        except GeneratorExit:
            with subscriber_lock:
                if sub in subscribers:
                    subscribers.remove(sub)
    
    return Response(event_stream(), mimetype='text/event-stream')

@app.route('/status')
def status():
    return jsonify({
        'coherence': 0.987,
        'faces': 192,
        'tetrahedra': 64,
        'resonance': '8009 Hz',
        'epsilon': guardian.epsilon,
        'alpha': mobius.alpha
    })

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=False, threaded=True)

    def transcribe_audio(self, audio_path: Path) -> Dict:
        """Transcribe audio file using Whisper (offline)"""
        try:
            # This would interface with whisper.cpp or local Whisper

            transcript = self._simulate_whisper(audio_path)

    def _simulate_whisper(self, audio_path: Path) -> str:
        """Simulate Whisper transcription (replace with actual whisper.cpp)"""
        # In production, this would call:
        # whisper.cpp or openai-whisper (offline)
        
        # Read audio metadata
        try:
            with wave.open(str(audio_path), 'rb') as wav_file:
                frames = wav_file.getnframes()
                rate = wav_file.getframerate()
                duration = frames / float(rate)
                
                # Simulate transcription based on file properties
                if "car" in audio_path.name.lower():
                    return "The vehicle requires maintenance. Engine temperature is elevated."
                elif "shelter" in audio_path.name.lower():

                else:
                    return f"Audio recording {audio_path.name} duration {duration:.1f}s. Contains spoken content about unknown topic."
        except:
            return "Transcription: [Audio content processed] This is a simulated transcript for demonstration."
    
    def _apply_spark_tagging(self, transcript: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Apply 8D SPARK tagging to transcript"""
        spark_vector = {}
        
        # Analyze transcript for each dimension
        text_lower = transcript.lower()
        
        # Domain detection
        for domain in self.spark_dimensions['domain']:
            if domain in text_lower:
                spark_vector[f"domain_{domain}"] = 0.8
            else:
                spark_vector[f"domain_{domain}"] = 0.1
        
        # Time references
        time_words = ['yesterday', 'today', 'tomorrow', 'now', 'soon', 'later']
        time_score = sum(1 for word in time_words if word in text_lower) / len(time_words)
        spark_vector['time_density'] = time_score
        
        # Space references
        space_words = ['here', 'there', 'everywhere', 'local', 'global']
        space_score = sum(1 for word in space_words if word in text_lower) / len(space_words)
        spark_vector['space_density'] = space_score
        
        # Identity references
        identity_words = ['I', 'we', 'you', 'they', 'everyone', 'someone']
        identity_score = sum(1 for word in identity_words if word.lower() in text_lower) / len(identity_words)
        spark_vector['identity_density'] = identity_score
        
        # Intent classification
        if '?' in transcript:
            spark_vector['intent_query'] = 0.9
        if any(cmd in text_lower for cmd in ['should', 'must', 'need to', 'please']):
            spark_vector['intent_command'] = 0.7
        if any(stmt in text_lower for stmt in ['is', 'are', 'was', 'were']):
            spark_vector['intent_statement'] = 0.8
        
        # Modality (default is voice)
        spark_vector['modality_voice'] = 1.0
        
        # Ethical dimensions
        ethical_score = 0.5  # Neutral baseline
        positive_words = ['help', 'good', 'better', 'improve', 'support']
        negative_words = ['harm', 'bad', 'worse', 'hurt', 'damage']
        
        ethical_score += sum(0.1 for word in positive_words if word in text_lower)
        ethical_score -= sum(0.1 for word in negative_words if word in text_lower)
        spark_vector['ethics_score'] = max(0.0, min(1.0, ethical_score))
        
        # Energy level (based on punctuation and caps)
        exclamations = transcript.count('!')
        questions = transcript.count('?')
        caps_ratio = sum(1 for c in transcript if c.isupper()) / max(1, len(transcript))
        
        energy = 0.5 + (exclamations * 0.1) + (caps_ratio * 0.3) - (questions * 0.05)
        spark_vector['energy_level'] = max(0.0, min(1.0, energy))
        
        return spark_vector
    
    def _expand_to_42d(self, spark_vector: Dict, transcript: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Expand 8D SPARK vector to 42D resonance vector"""
        resonance = {}
        
        # Base each resonance dimension on SPARK components
        text_hash = hash(transcript) % 1000 / 1000.0
        
        for i, dim in enumerate(self.resonance_dimensions):
            # Create unique resonance score based on SPARK components and position
            base_score = 0.5
            
            # Add influence from SPARK dimensions
            if 'ethics_score' in spark_vector:
                base_score += (spark_vector['ethics_score'] - 0.5) * 0.2
            
            if 'energy_level' in spark_vector:
                base_score += (spark_vector['energy_level'] - 0.5) * 0.1
            
            # Add cyclic patterns
            cycle = np.sin(i * np.pi / len(self.resonance_dimensions) + text_hash * 2 * np.pi)
            base_score += cycle * 0.1
            
            # Add golden ratio pattern
            golden = (i * 0.6180339887) % 1.0
            base_score += (golden - 0.5) * 0.05
            
            resonance[dim] = max(0.0, min(1.0, base_score))
        
        return resonance
    
    def _create_tofar_metadata(self, audio_path: Path, transcript: str) -> Dict:
        """Create TOFAR (Timestamp, Origin, File, Audio, Result) provenance"""
        audio_hash = hashlib.sha256(audio_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
        text_hash = hashlib.sha256(transcript.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        
        return {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'origin': 'whisper_offline',
            'file': audio_path.name,
            'audio_hash': audio_hash,
            'text_hash': text_hash,
            'trust_score': 0.92,
            'coherence_2026': self._calculate_coherence_metric(transcript)
        }
    
    def _calculate_coherence_metric(self, transcript: str) -> float:
        """Calculate 2026 coherence metric"""
        # Metrics for high-quality transcription
        metrics = {
            'length_score': min(1.0, len(transcript.split()) / 50),  # Target 50+ words
            'punctuation_score': sum(1 for c in transcript if c in '.!?,') / max(1, len(transcript.split())),
            'capitalization_score': transcript[0].isupper() if transcript else 0.0,
            'diversity_score': len(set(transcript.lower().split())) / max(1, len(transcript.split()))
        }
        
        # Weighted average
        weights = {'length_score': 0.3, 'punctuation_score': 0.3, 
                  'capitalization_score': 0.2, 'diversity_score': 0.2}
        
        coherence = sum(metrics[k] * weights[k] for k in metrics)
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, coherence))
    
    async def process_audio_directory(self, audio_dir: Path):

                print(f"   ✓ SPARK: {len(result['spark_8d'])}D")
                print(f"   ✓ Resonance: {len(result['resonance_42d'])}D")
                print(f"   ✓ Coherence: {result['tofar']['coherence_2026']:.3f}")
        
        return results

# ========== CONCEPT STORE LATTICE ==========

class ConceptStoreLattice:
    """Knowledge lattice for semantic storage and querying"""
    
    def __init__(self, store_path: Path = Path("./concept_store/")):
        self.store_path = store_path
        self.store_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Graph database (simulated with JSON)
        self.nodes = []
        self.edges = []
        
        # Load existing lattice
        self._load_lattice()
        
        print(f"🏛️  Concept Store Lattice Initialized")
        print(f"   Location: {store_path.absolute()}")
        print(f"   Nodes: {len(self.nodes)}")
        print(f"   Edges: {len(self.edges)}")
    
    def _load_lattice(self):
        """Load existing lattice from disk"""
        lattice_file = self.store_path / "lattice.json"
        if lattice_file.exists():
            try:
                with open(lattice_file, 'r') as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    self.nodes = data.get('nodes', [])
                    self.edges = data.get('edges', [])
            except:
                self.nodes = []
                self.edges = []
    
    def _save_lattice(self):
        """Save lattice to disk"""
        lattice_file = self.store_path / "lattice.json"
        data = {
            'nodes': self.nodes,
            'edges': self.edges,
            'updated': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'version': '1.0'
        }
        with open(lattice_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    
    def ingest_semantic_result(self, whisper_result: Dict) -> str:
        """Ingest Whisper++ semantic result into lattice"""
        # Create node
        node_id = f"voice_{hashlib.sha256(whisper_result['transcript'].encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}"
        
        node = {
            'id': node_id,
            'type': 'voice_transcript',
            'timestamp': whisper_result['timestamp'],
            'transcript': whisper_result['transcript'],
            'spark_8d': whisper_result['spark_8d'],
            'resonance_42d': whisper_result['resonance_42d'],
            'tofar': whisper_result['tofar'],
            'audio_source': whisper_result['audio_file'],
            'ingestion_time': datetime.now().isoformat()
        }
        
        self.nodes.append(node)
        
        # Create edges to similar nodes
        for other_node in self.nodes:
            if other_node['id'] != node_id:
                similarity = self._calculate_semantic_similarity(node, other_node)
                if similarity > 0.3:  # Threshold
                    edge = {
                        'from': node_id,
                        'to': other_node['id'],
                        'type': 'semantic_similarity',
                        'strength': similarity,
                        'dimensions': self._get_shared_dimensions(node, other_node)
                    }
                    self.edges.append(edge)
        
        # Save updates
        self._save_lattice()
        
        print(f"🏛️  Ingested: {node_id}")
        print(f"   Transcript: {whisper_result['transcript'][:50]}...")
        print(f"   Connections: {sum(1 for e in self.edges if e['from'] == node_id or e['to'] == node_id)}")
        
        return node_id
    
    def _calculate_semantic_similarity(self, node1: Dict, node2: Dict) -> float:
        """Calculate semantic similarity between nodes"""
        # Compare resonance vectors
        if 'resonance_42d' in node1 and 'resonance_42d' in node2:
            vec1 = list(node1['resonance_42d'].values())
            vec2 = list(node2['resonance_42d'].values())
            
            # Cosine similarity
            dot = sum(a*b for a,b in zip(vec1, vec2))
            norm1 = sum(a*a for a in vec1) ** 0.5
            norm2 = sum(b*b for b in vec2) ** 0.5
            
            if norm1 > 0 and norm2 > 0:
                return dot / (norm1 * norm2)
        
        return 0.0
    
    def _get_shared_dimensions(self, node1: Dict, node2: Dict) -> List[str]:
        """Get shared semantic dimensions"""
        shared = []
        
        # Compare SPARK dimensions
        if 'spark_8d' in node1 and 'spark_8d' in node2:
            for dim in node1['spark_8d']:
                if dim in node2['spark_8d']:
                    if node1['spark_8d'][dim] > 0.5 and node2['spark_8d'][dim] > 0.5:
                        shared.append(dim)
        
        return shared
    
    def query_by_concept(self, concept: str, threshold: float = 0.5) -> List[Dict]:
        """Query lattice by semantic concept"""
        results = []
        
        for node in self.nodes:
            # Check transcript
            if concept.lower() in node.get('transcript', '').lower():
                results.append(node)
                continue
            
            # Check SPARK dimensions
            spark_match = False
            for dim, value in node.get('spark_8d', {}).items():
                if concept.lower() in dim.lower() and value > threshold:
                    spark_match = True
                    break
            
            if spark_match:
                results.append(node)
                continue
            
            # Check resonance dimensions
            for dim, value in node.get('resonance_42d', {}).items():
                if concept.lower() in dim.lower() and value > threshold:
                    results.append(node)
                    break
        
        return results
    
    def get_visualization_data(self) -> Dict:
        """Get data for glyph visualization"""
        return {
            'nodes': [
                {
                    'id': node['id'],
                    'type': node['type'],
                    'coherence': node.get('tofar', {}).get('coherence_2026', 0.5),
                    'spark_density': len([v for v in node.get('spark_8d', {}).values() if v > 0.5]),
                    'resonance_energy': sum(node.get('resonance_42d', {}).values()) / 42.0
                }
                for node in self.nodes[:50]  # Limit for visualization
            ],
            'edges': self.edges[:100]  # Limit for visualization
        }

# ========== INTEGRATION WITH ETERNAL SEASEER ==========

class WhisperSeaseerIntegration:
    """Integrate Whisper++ with Eternal Seaseer system"""
    
    def __init__(self, whisper: WhisperPlusPlus, concept_store: ConceptStoreLattice):
        self.whisper = whisper
        self.concept_store = concept_store
        self.phase_anchors = []
        
        print("🌌 Whisper++ + Eternal Seaseer Integration")
        print("   Offline Voice → Semantic Lattice → Eternal Knowledge")
    
    async def process_and_integrate(self, audio_dir: Path):
        """Process audio and integrate with Eternal Seaseer"""
        # Process audio files
        results = await self.whisper.process_audio_directory(audio_dir)
        
        # Ingest into concept store
        for result in results:
            node_id = self.concept_store.ingest_semantic_result(result)
            
            # Create PhaseAnchor for Eternal Seaseer
            phase_anchor = self._create_phase_anchor(result, node_id)
            self.phase_anchors.append(phase_anchor)
            
            # Save PhaseAnchor
            anchor_path = Path("./phase_anchors/") / f"{node_id}.yaml"
            anchor_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            with open(anchor_path, 'w') as f:
                yaml.dump(phase_anchor, f, default_flow_style=False)
            
            print(f"🌀 Created PhaseAnchor: {phase_anchor['anchor_id']}")
            print(f"   Coherence: {phase_anchor['coherence_score']:.3f}")
            print(f"   Ethics Gates: {len(phase_anchor['ethical_gates'])}")
        
        print(f"\n✅ Processing complete:")
        print(f"   Audio files: {len(results)}")
        print(f"   PhaseAnchors: {len(self.phase_anchors)}")
        print(f"   Lattice nodes: {len(self.concept_store.nodes)}")
        print(f"   Lattice edges: {len(self.concept_store.edges)}")
    
    def _create_phase_anchor(self, whisper_result: Dict, node_id: str) -> Dict:
        """Create Eternal Seaseer PhaseAnchor from Whisper result"""
        
        # Extract key concepts from transcript
        transcript = whisper_result['transcript']
        words = transcript.lower().split()
        
        # Map to Eternal Seaseer concepts
        concept_map = {
            'vehicle': 'motion',
            'maintenance': 'care',
            'temperature': 'energy',
            'supplies': 'abundance',
            'blankets': 'warmth',
            'food': 'nourishment',
            'medical': 'healing',
            'patient': 'being',
            'symptoms': 'pattern',
            'fatigue': 'energy_low',
            'disorientation': 'coherence_low'
        }
        
        concepts = []
        for word in words:
            if word in concept_map and concept_map[word] not in concepts:
                concepts.append(concept_map[word])
        
        # Create concept vector
        concept_vector = {concept: 1.0 for concept in concepts}
        
        # Add resonance dimensions
        for dim, value in whisper_result['resonance_42d'].items():
            if value > 0.7:  # Strong resonances
                concept_vector[f"resonance_{dim}"] = value
        
        return {
            'anchor_id': f"voice_{node_id}",
            'timestamp': whisper_result['timestamp'],
            'concept_vector': concept_vector,
            'dna_signature': f"DNA_{whisper_result['tofar']['text_hash']}",
            'tofar_hash': f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(transcript.encode()).hexdigest()}",
            'coherence_score': whisper_result['tofar']['coherence_2026'],
            'ethical_gates': ['Truth', 'Care', 'Justice', 'Harmony'],
            'carrier_modalities': ['voice', 'text', 'semantic'],
            'replay_path': whisper_result['audio_file'],
            'origin_threads': [
                f"voice://{Path(whisper_result['audio_file']).name}",
                "thread://offline_asr",
                "thread://semantic_lattice"
            ],
            'whisper_metadata': {
                'transcript_length': len(transcript),
                'spark_dimensions': len(whisper_result['spark_8d']),
                'resonance_dimensions': len(whisper_result['resonance_42d']),
                'trust_score': whisper_result['tofar']['trust_score']
            }
        }
    
    def generate_dashboard(self):
        """Generate visualization dashboard"""
        viz_data = self.concept_store.get_visualization_data()
        
        dashboard = {
            'system': 'Whisper++ + Eternal Seaseer',
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'metrics': {
                'audio_processed': len(self.phase_anchors),
                'lattice_nodes': len(self.concept_store.nodes),
                'lattice_edges': len(self.concept_store.edges),
                'average_coherence': np.mean([a['coherence_score'] for a in self.phase_anchors]) if self.phase_anchors else 0.0,
                'concept_diversity': len(set().union(*[list(a['concept_vector'].keys()) for a in self.phase_anchors])) if self.phase_anchors else 0
            },
            'recent_anchors': [
                {
                    'id': a['anchor_id'],
                    'concepts': list(a['concept_vector'].keys())[:5],
                    'coherence': a['coherence_score'],
                    'timestamp': a['timestamp']
                }
                for a in self.phase_anchors[-5:]
            ],
            'visualization': viz_data
        }
        
        # Save dashboard
        dashboard_path = Path("./dashboard/whisper_seaseer_dashboard.json")
        dashboard_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        with open(dashboard_path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(dashboard, f, indent=2)
        
        print(f"📊 Dashboard generated: {dashboard_path}")
        
        return dashboard

# ========== FASTAPI ENDPOINTS ==========

from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, HTMLResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
import uvicorn

app = FastAPI(title="Whisper++ Concept Store API")

# Global instances
whisper_pp = None
concept_store = None
integration = None

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup_event():
    """Initialize services on startup"""
    global whisper_pp, concept_store, integration
    
    whisper_pp = WhisperPlusPlus(model_size="base")
    concept_store = ConceptStoreLattice()
    integration = WhisperSeaseerIntegration(whisper_pp, concept_store)
    
    print("🚀 Whisper++ Concept Store API Started")
    print("   Endpoints:")
    print("   - POST /transcribe")
    print("   - POST /concept-store/ingest")
    print("   - GET /concept-store/query")
    print("   - GET /dashboard")

@app.post("/transcribe")
async def transcribe_audio(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    """Transcribe audio file"""
    try:
        # Save uploaded file
        temp_path = Path(f"./temp/{file.filename}")
        temp_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        content = await file.read()
        temp_path.write_bytes(content)
        
        # Transcribe
        result = whisper_pp.transcribe_audio(temp_path)
        
        if not result:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Transcription failed")
        
        # Cleanup
        temp_path.unlink()
        
        return JSONResponse(content=result)
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.post("/concept-store/ingest")
async def ingest_transcription(transcription_data: Dict):
    """Ingest transcription into concept store"""
    try:
        node_id = concept_store.ingest_semantic_result(transcription_data)
        
        # Also create PhaseAnchor
        phase_anchor = integration._create_phase_anchor(transcription_data, node_id)
        integration.phase_anchors.append(phase_anchor)
        
        return JSONResponse(content={
            "status": "ingested",
            "node_id": node_id,
            "anchor_id": phase_anchor['anchor_id'],
            "concept_count": len(phase_anchor['concept_vector'])
        })
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.get("/concept-store/query")
async def query_concepts(concept: str, threshold: float = 0.5):
    """Query concept store by semantic concept"""
    try:
        results = concept_store.query_by_concept(concept, threshold)
        
        return JSONResponse(content={
            "concept": concept,
            "threshold": threshold,
            "count": len(results),
            "results": [
                {
                    "id": r["id"],
                    "type": r["type"],
                    "transcript_preview": r["transcript"][:100] + "..." if len(r["transcript"]) > 100 else r["transcript"],
                    "timestamp": r["timestamp"],
                    "coherence": r.get("tofar", {}).get("coherence_2026", 0.0)
                }
                for r in results[:10]  # Limit results
            ]
        })
        
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.get("/dashboard")
async def get_dashboard():
    """Get system dashboard"""
    try:
        dashboard = integration.generate_dashboard()
        return JSONResponse(content=dashboard)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

async def main_cli():
    """Command-line interface for the system"""
    
    print("🎤 WHISPER++ + ETERNAL SEASEER")
    print("=" * 60)
    
    # Initialize
    whisper = WhisperPlusPlus(model_size="base")
    store = ConceptStoreLattice()
    integration = WhisperSeaseerIntegration(whisper, store)
    
    # Create sample audio directory
    audio_dir = Path("./audio_samples/")
    audio_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    
    # Create sample audio metadata files (in real use, these would be actual audio files)
    samples = [
        {
            "name": "car_maintenance.wav",
            "content": "Vehicle maintenance log. Engine temperature elevated, recommend coolant check."
        },
        {
            "name": "shelter_intake.mp3",
            "content": "Shelter intake recording. Need blankets, non-perishable food, and medical supplies."
        },
        {
            "name": "patient_intake.flac",
            "content": "Patient presents with fatigue, disorientation, and mild dehydration. Vital signs stable."
        }
    ]
    
    for sample in samples:
        # Create text file as placeholder for audio
        text_file = audio_dir / sample["name"].replace(".wav", ".txt").replace(".mp3", ".txt").replace(".flac", ".txt")
        text_file.write_text(sample["content"])
    
    print(f"\n📁 Created sample audio files in: {audio_dir}")
    
    # Process samples
    await integration.process_and_integrate(audio_dir)
    
    # Generate dashboard
    dashboard = integration.generate_dashboard()
    
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("🏛️  CONCEPT STORE QUERY EXAMPLES")
    print("=" * 60)
    
    # Example queries
    queries = ["health", "vehicle", "supplies", "energy"]
    for query in queries:
        results = store.query_by_concept(query, threshold=0.3)
        print(f"\n🔍 Query: '{query}' → {len(results)} results")
        for result in results[:2]:  # Show first 2
            print(f"   • {result['transcript'][:50]}...")
    
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("🚀 STARTING API SERVER")
    print("=" * 60)
    print("\nVisit: http://localhost:5010")
    print("\nEndpoints:")
    print("  - /transcribe (POST audio file)")
    print("  - /concept-store/query?concept=health")
    print("  - /dashboard")
    print("\nPress Ctrl+C to stop server")
    
    # Start FastAPI server
    config = uvicorn.Config(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5010, log_level="info")
    server = uvicorn.Server(config)
    await server.serve()

# ========== MAIN EXECUTION ==========

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Whisper++ Concept Store System")
    parser.add_argument("--api", action="store_true", help="Start API server")
    parser.add_argument("--cli", action="store_true", help="Run command-line interface")
    parser.add_argument("--process", type=str, help="Process audio directory")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if args.api:
        # Start API server
        uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5010)
    
    elif args.process:
        # Process audio directory
        async def process_dir():
            whisper = WhisperPlusPlus()
            store = ConceptStoreLattice()
            integration = WhisperSeaseerIntegration(whisper, store)
            
            audio_dir = Path(args.process)
            if not audio_dir.exists():
                print(f"❌ Directory not found: {audio_dir}")
                return
            
            await integration.process_and_integrate(audio_dir)
            integration.generate_dashboard()
        
        asyncio.run(process_dir())
    
    elif args.cli:
        # Run CLI
        asyncio.run(main_cli())
    
    else:
        # Default: run CLI
        asyncio.run(main_cli())

refinery/extract.py (unzip + PDF/text extract)
import os, zipfile, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

def sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def unpack_if_zip(path: Path, unpack_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".zip":
        return [path]
    unpack_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as z:
        z.extractall(unpack_dir / path.stem)
    return list((unpack_dir / path.stem).rglob("*"))

def extract_text(path: Path) -> str:
    suf = path.suffix.lower()
    if suf in [".txt", ".md", ".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".py", ".js", ".html"]:
        data = path.read_text(errors="ignore")
        if suf == ".html":
            soup = BeautifulSoup(data, "html.parser")
            return soup.get_text("\n")
        return data

    if suf == ".pdf":
        # Try PyMuPDF first
        try:
            import fitz  # pymupdf
            doc = fitz.open(str(path))
            parts = []
            for i in range(len(doc)):
                parts.append(doc.load_page(i).get_text("text"))
            return "\n".join(parts)
        except Exception:
            # fallback pdfminer
            from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text as pdfminer_extract
            return pdfminer_extract(str(path))

    return ""  # ignore binaries by default

def artifact_record(path: Path, raw_text: str) -> dict:
    b = raw_text.encode(errors="ignore")
    return {
        "path": str(path),
        "filename": path.name,
        "ext": path.suffix.lower(),
        "sha256": sha256_bytes(b),
        "bytes": len(b),
    }
refinery/parse.py (headings + identifiers + links)
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from slugify import slugify

HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$", re.M)
URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\)>\]]+")
ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(FHOME|F\d{4}|F\d{4}\-\w+|TOFAR|SevenGates|EdgeGate|BrickCake|Whisper\+\+)\b")

@dataclass
class Section:
    sid: str
    title: str
    level: int
    text: str
    links: list[str]
    identifiers: list[str]

def split_sections(doc_id: str, text: str) -> list[Section]:
    matches = list(HEADING_RE.finditer(text))
    if not matches:
        links = URL_RE.findall(text)
        ids = sorted(set(ID_RE.findall(text)))
        return [Section(sid=f"{doc_id}::root", title="root", level=1, text=text, links=links, identifiers=ids)]

    sections: list[Section] = []
    for i, m in enumerate(matches):
        level = len(m.group(1))
        title = m.group(2).strip()
        start = m.end()
        end = matches[i+1].start() if i+1 < len(matches) else len(text)
        body = text[start:end].strip()
        sid = f"{doc_id}::{slugify(title)[:64]}::{i}"
        sections.append(Section(
            sid=sid,
            title=title,
            level=level,
            text=body,
            links=URL_RE.findall(body),
            identifiers=sorted(set(ID_RE.findall(body))),
        ))
    return sections
refinery/dedup.py (dethatching via SimHash)
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

def _tokens(s: str) -> list[str]:
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,}", s)

def simhash64(text: str) -> int:
    # tiny SimHash (no deps)
    v = [0]*64
    for t in _tokens(text):
        h = hash(t) & ((1<<64)-1)
        for i in range(64):
            v[i] += 1 if (h >> i) & 1 else -1
    out = 0
    for i in range(64):
        if v[i] > 0:
            out |= (1<<i)
    return out

def hamming(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return (a ^ b).bit_count()
refinery/lattice.py (concept lattice JSON)
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Any
from .dedup import simhash64, hamming

@dataclass
class Lattice:
    nodes: list[dict]
    edges: list[dict]

def build_vectors(text: str, domain_labels: list[str], intent_labels: list[str], tofar: list[str]) -> dict:
    t = text.lower()
    def score(words: list[str]) -> float:
        return min(1.0, sum(1 for w in words if w in t) / max(3, len(words)))

    domain = {d: score([d]) for d in domain_labels}
    intent = {i: score([i]) for i in intent_labels}

    # very simple TOFAR-ish heuristic (replace with your real map later)
    tofar_vec = {
        "truth_seeking": score(["truth", "verify", "evidence", "audit"]),
        "action_oriented": score(["deploy", "run", "wire", "implement"]),
        "foundation_check": score(["spec", "invariant", "schema", "contract"]),
        "ethical_inquiry": score(["ethic", "harm", "consent", "guardian"]),
        "pattern_recognition": score(["map", "lattice", "dedup", "correlate"]),
    }
    return {"domain": domain, "intent": intent, "tofar": tofar_vec}

def dedup_sections(sections: list[dict], near_hamming: int) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:
    kept = []
    edges = []
    seen = []  # list of (sid, simhash)
    for s in sections:
        sh = simhash64(s["text"])
        dup_of = None
        for (sid0, sh0) in seen:
            if hamming(sh, sh0) <= near_hamming:
                dup_of = sid0
                break
        if dup_of:
            edges.append({"type":"near_duplicate_of","from":s["id"],"to":dup_of,"weight":1.0})
        else:
            s["simhash64"] = f"{sh}"
            kept.append(s)
            seen.append((s["id"], sh))
    return kept, edges

def build_lattice(doc_nodes: list[dict], section_nodes: list[dict], extra_edges: list[dict]) -> Lattice:
    return Lattice(nodes=doc_nodes + section_nodes, edges=extra_edges)
refinery/opus.py (regenerate the harmony doc)
from datetime import datetime

def render_opus(title: str, version: str, lattice: dict) -> str:
    nodes = lattice["nodes"]
    edges = lattice["edges"]

    docs = [n for n in nodes if n.get("type") == "document"]
    secs = [n for n in nodes if n.get("type") == "section"]

    # top identifiers
    ident_counts = {}
    for s in secs:
        for ident in s.get("identifiers", []):
            ident_counts[ident] = ident_counts.get(ident, 0) + 1
    top_idents = sorted(ident_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:20]

    # link index
    link_counts = {}
    for s in secs:
        for u in s.get("links", []):
            link_counts[u] = link_counts.get(u, 0) + 1
    top_links = sorted(link_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:30]

    lines = []
    lines.append(f"# {title} ({version})")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"*Generated:* {datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}Z")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Core assertion")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("**Everything is an event.** Artifacts ingest → normalize → lattice → projections (UI/docs/exports).")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## What’s online")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("- Universal ingestion (mail + dock) → normalized event")
    lines.append("- BrickCake event store + HUD projection")
    lines.append("- Viewport + SSE emitter + touch sensor API")
    lines.append("- Flow control modes (trickle/low/high/full) for bandwidth + privacy posture")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Lattice summary")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"- Documents: **{len(docs)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Sections (deduped): **{len(secs)}**")
    lines.append(f"- Edges: **{len(edges)}**")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Top identifiers")
    lines.append("")
    for ident, c in top_idents:
        lines.append(f"- `{ident}` — {c}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Link index (highest frequency)")
    lines.append("")
    for url, c in top_links:
        lines.append(f"- {url} — {c}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Next concrete node: Uncertainty Refinery")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("**UncertaintyEvent → 4 variants + 2 madlibs → signpost → cliff note → lattice update → opus regen**")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Operational loop")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("1. Drop artifacts into `./artifacts_inbox/`")
    lines.append("2. Refinery runs: unzip + extract + parse + dedup + lattice rebuild")
    lines.append("3. Emits `NormalizedEvent(type=artifact_ingested|opus_regenerated)` into BrickCake")
    lines.append("4. Viewport subscribes and updates projections")
    lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)
refinery/uncertainty.py (your fractionator, now real)
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib

LENSES = ["nostalgia", "hall_of_mirrors", "simulated_expansion", "ghost_town_resonance"]

@dataclass
class UncertaintyEvent:
    uid: str
    text: str
    origin: str
    ts: str

def _hid(s: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(s.encode(errors="ignore")).hexdigest()[:16]

def fractionate(ev: UncertaintyEvent) -> dict:
    variants = []
    for lens in LENSES:
        variants.append({
            "lens": lens,
            "definition": f"[{lens}] {ev.text}".strip()
        })

    madlibs = [
        {"style":"essence_extraction", "text": f"Essence: {ev.text[:220]}"},
        {"style":"contextual_precipitate", "text": f"Signpost: when this pattern recurs → retrieve {_hid(ev.text)}"},
    ]

    signpost = {
        "id": f"signpost_{_hid(ev.text)}",
        "triangles_depth": 7,
        "ghost_band_hint": "50-54MHz",
        "rgb_mapping": {"green":"sing", "red":"anchor", "blue":"fractional"},
    }

    cliff_note = {
        "id": f"cliff_{_hid(ev.text)}",
        "one_liner": ev.text[:160],
        "retrieval_keys": [_hid(ev.text), ev.origin],
    }

    return {
        "type": "uncertainty_fractionated",
        "uid": ev.uid,
        "ts": ev.ts,
        "variants": variants,
        "madlibs": madlibs,
        "signpost": signpost,
        "cliff_note": cliff_note,
    }

def new_uncertainty(text: str, origin: str) -> UncertaintyEvent:
    ts = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
    uid = f"u_{_hid(ts + '|' + origin + '|' + text)}"
    return UncertaintyEvent(uid=uid, text=text, origin=origin, ts=ts)
refinery/guardian.py (minimal, honest gate)
def guardian_action(text: str) -> dict:
    """
    Simple action triad:
      ALLOW: normal ingest
      HARMONIZE: downscope output (redact links/secrets)
      SUBSTREAM: safe simulation (store locally, do not emit externally)
    """
    t = text.lower()
    risk = 0
    risk += 2 if "password" in t or "api key" in t or "secret" in t else 0
    risk += 1 if "private" in t or "ssn" in t else 0

    if risk >= 2:
        return {"action":"SUBSTREAM", "confidence":0.9}
    if risk == 1:
        return {"action":"HARMONIZE", "confidence":0.7}
    return {"action":"ALLOW", "confidence":0.8}
refinery/emit.py (normalized event → BrickCake)
import requests
from datetime import datetime

def emit(brickcake_url: str, event: dict, enabled: bool = True) -> None:
    if not enabled:
        return
    payload = {
        "ts": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        "type": "normalized_event",
        "event": event,
    }
    try:
        requests.post(brickcake_url, json=payload, timeout=2.0)
    except Exception:
        # never crash the refinery due to network
        pass
refinery/cli.py (the one command you actually use)
import json
from pathlib import Path
from watchdog.observers import Observer
from watchdog.events import FileSystemEventHandler

from .config import RefineryConfig
from .extract import unpack_if_zip, extract_text, artifact_record
from .parse import split_sections
from .lattice import build_vectors, dedup_sections, build_lattice
from .opus import render_opus
from .emit import emit
from .guardian import guardian_action

def run_ingest(in_path: str, cfg: RefineryConfig) -> None:
    in_path = str(in_path)
    p = Path(in_path)
    out = Path(cfg.out_dir); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache = Path(cfg.cache_dir); cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 1) expand inputs
    files = []
    if p.is_dir():
        for q in p.rglob("*"):
            if q.is_file():
                files.extend(unpack_if_zip(q, cache))
    else:
        files.extend(unpack_if_zip(p, cache))

    # 2) extract
    doc_nodes = []
    sec_nodes = []

    for f in files:
        if not f.is_file():
            continue
        text = extract_text(f)
        if not text.strip():
            continue

        g = guardian_action(text)
        doc_id = f"doc::{f.name}"
        doc = artifact_record(f, text)
        doc_nodes.append({"id": doc_id, "type":"document", **doc, "guardian": g})

        # 3) parse sections
        for s in split_sections(doc_id, text):
            vec = build_vectors(s.text, cfg.domain_labels, cfg.intent_labels, cfg.tofar_classes)
            sec_nodes.append({
                "id": s.sid,
                "type":"section",
                "doc": doc_id,
                "title": s.title,
                "level": s.level,
                "text": s.text,
                "links": s.links,
                "identifiers": s.identifiers,
                "vector": vec,
            })

    # 4) dedup
    sec_nodes_kept, dedup_edges = dedup_sections(sec_nodes, cfg.near_dup_hamming)

    # 5) lattice
    lattice = build_lattice(doc_nodes, sec_nodes_kept, dedup_edges)
    lattice_json = {"nodes": lattice.nodes, "edges": lattice.edges}

    (out / "concept_lattice.json").write_text(json.dumps(lattice_json, indent=2))
    opus = render_opus(cfg.opus_title, cfg.opus_version, lattice_json)
    (out / "GRAND_OPUS.md").write_text(opus)

    # 6) emit events
    emit(cfg.brickcake_url, {"type":"lattice_built", "docs": len(doc_nodes), "sections": len(sec_nodes_kept)}, cfg.emit_enabled)
    emit(cfg.brickcake_url, {"type":"opus_regenerated", "path": str(out / "GRAND_OPUS.md")}, cfg.emit_enabled)

class _Watch(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def __init__(self, folder: str, cfg: RefineryConfig):
        self.folder = folder
        self.cfg = cfg
    def on_any_event(self, event):
        if event.is_directory:
            return
        run_ingest(self.folder, self.cfg)

def watch(folder: str, cfg: RefineryConfig) -> None:
    obs = Observer()
    obs.schedule(_Watch(folder, cfg), folder, recursive=True)
    obs.start()
    try:
        import time
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    finally:
        obs.stop()
        obs.join()

## Minimal working “Graphic Dynamics Engine” (backend + browser HUD)

### server.py (FastAPI + SSE)

python
# pip install fastapi uvicorn
import asyncio, json, time, math
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field
from typing import List, Dict, Literal, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, StreamingResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

Phase = Literal["inhale", "process", "exhale"]

@dataclass
class EthicsState:
    gateScores: List[float] = field(default_factory=lambda: [1.0]*7)
    verdict: Literal["allow","soft_block","block"] = "allow"

@dataclass
class RingState:
    configPresent: bool = True
    activeGates: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    activeLanes: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Node:
    id: str
    kind: str
    x: float
    y: float
    w: Optional[float] = None
    h: Optional[float] = None
    r: Optional[float] = None
    activity: float = 0.0
    payload: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class Edge:
    a: str
    b: str
    w: float

@dataclass
class Mark:
    kind: str
    x: float
    y: float
    strength: float
    label: str = ""

@dataclass
class Scene:
    t: float
    phase: Phase
    coherence: float
    ethics: EthicsState
    rings: RingState
    nodes: List[Node]
    edges: List[Edge]
    substrateMarks: List[Mark]

app = FastAPI()

app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

def phase_of(u: float) -> Phase:
    # u in [0,1)
    if u < 1/3: return "inhale"
    if u < 2/3: return "process"
    return "exhale"

async def scene_generator():
    start = time.time()
    while True:
        now = time.time()
        u = ((now - start) % 6.0) / 6.0  # 6s cycle
        phase = phase_of(u)

        # coherence breath curve (0..1)
        coh = 0.5 + 0.5*math.sin(2*math.pi*u - math.pi/2)

        # gates: simple demo — clamp + pulse
        gate_scores = [max(0.0, min(1.0, 0.65 + 0.35*math.sin(2*math.pi*u + i))) for i in range(7)]
        verdict = "allow" if min(gate_scores) > 0.25 else "soft_block"

        rings = RingState(
            configPresent=True,
            activeGates=[i for i,s in enumerate(gate_scores) if s > 0.75],
            activeLanes=[3, 9, 11] if phase != "process" else [9]
        )

        nodes = [
            Node("sensor_mesh","cloud",0.10,0.52, w=0.22,h=0.26, activity=0.35+0.45*coh),
            Node("comms_in","pipe",0.36,0.52, w=0.14,h=0.26, activity=0.25+0.55*coh),
            Node("mobiius_center","c60",0.58,0.50, r=0.18, activity=0.55+0.40*coh, payload="forecast_packet"),
            Node("tofar","ledger",0.78,0.74, w=0.20,h=0.18, activity=0.40+0.50*coh),
        ]
        edges = [
            Edge("sensor_mesh","comms_in", 0.40+0.60*coh),
            Edge("comms_in","mobiius_center", 0.60+0.40*coh),
            Edge("mobiius_center","tofar", 0.55+0.45*coh),
        ]
        marks = [
            Mark("defect", 0.06+0.02*math.sin(10*u), 0.12+0.02*math.cos(11*u), 0.2+0.6*coh, "breath_stamp")
        ]

        scene = Scene(
            t=now,
            phase=phase,
            coherence=coh,
            ethics=EthicsState(gateScores=gate_scores, verdict=verdict),
            rings=rings,
            nodes=nodes,
            edges=edges,
            substrateMarks=marks
        )

        yield "data: " + json.dumps(asdict(scene)) + "\n\n"
        await asyncio.sleep(1/20)  # 20 FPS-ish

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def root():
    return """
    <html>
      <head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/></head>
      <body style="margin:0;background:#0b0b0f;">
        <iframe src="/static/index.html" style="border:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;"></iframe>
      </body>
    </html>
    """

@app.get("/events")
async def events():
    return StreamingResponse(scene_generator(), media_type="text/event-stream")

function drawNode(n){
  const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;
  const x = n.x*W, y=n.y*H;

  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;

  if(n.kind==="c60"){
    const r = n.r*Math.min(W,H);

    // cage points (a cheap “buckyball vibe”)
    const pts = 60;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<pts;i++){
      const a = (i/pts)*Math.PI*2;
      const rr = r*(0.70 + 0.25*Math.sin(3*a));
      const px = x + rr*Math.cos(a);
      const py = y + rr*Math.sin(a);
      if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(200,220,255,${0.15+0.45*n.activity})`;
    ctx.stroke();

    // inner payload glow
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y, r*0.20, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.10+0.35*n.activity})`;
    ctx.fill();

    // ring: 7 gates
    for(let g=0; g<7; g++){
      const a0 = (g/7)*Math.PI*2;
      const a1 = ((g+1)/7)*Math.PI*2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x,y, r*1.05, a0, a1);
      ctx.lineWidth = r*0.08;
      const s = scene.ethics.gateScores[g];
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(140,255,200,${0.05+0.45*s})`;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // label
    ctx.font = "14px system-ui";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)";
    ctx.fillText(`center • ${scene.phase} • coh ${scene.coherence.toFixed(2)}`, x-r, y+r*1.35);
    ctx.fillText(`TOFAR verdict: ${scene.ethics.verdict}`, x-r, y+r*1.55);

    return;
  }

  // generic boxes
  const w = (n.w||0.12)*W, h=(n.h||0.12)*H;
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(140,170,255,${0.05+0.20*n.activity})`;
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(200,220,255,${0.10+0.35*n.activity})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(x-w/2,y-h/2,w,h,12);
  ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();

  ctx.font = "13px system-ui";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)";
  ctx.fillText(n.id, x-w/2+10, y);
}

function drawEdges(){
  const W=canvas.width, H=canvas.height;
  const pos = Object.fromEntries(scene.nodes.map(n=>[n.id,{x:n.x*W,y:n.y*H}]));
  for(const e of scene.edges){
    const a = pos[e.a], b=pos[e.b];
    if(!a||!b) continue;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 + 6*e.w*0.15;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.05+0.25*e.w})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawSubstrate(){
  // “graphene sheet” background + defect marks
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5,6,10,1)";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

  // subtle hex-ish noise
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  const step = 28;
  for(let y=0;y<canvas.height;y+=step){
    for(let x=0;x<canvas.width;x+=step){
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x+(y/step%2)*step*0.5, y, 1.2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // defect marks
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  for(const m of scene.substrateMarks){
    const x = m.x*canvas.width, y=m.y*canvas.height;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y, 2+10*m.strength, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,120,200,${0.05+0.25*m.strength})`;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,200,240,${0.08+0.35*m.strength})`;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function loop(){
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  if(!scene) return;

  drawSubstrate();
  drawEdges();
  for(const n of scene.nodes) drawNode(n);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
